evidence.detail: The constructor owns the gameframe control sprite inventory: HP/prayer/run/spec fills and icons, orb backgrounds/drain masks, adventure/promo/event orbs, hit/exp/heal/refill/boss/bank toggles, side arrows, plus gameframe chatbutton/hoverchat assets.
Client owns one rs/i/b instance and invokes its render/update methods from the live gameframe/HUD path; R304 GameHudRenderer also queries its active/layout state to shift multiple HUD elements.

Client menu-action routing calls rs/i/b.a(int) with exact R164 ChatMessageClassifier channel constants for chat-control selections, while other methods expose control visibility/toggle state and draw interactive gameframe controls.

Independent consumers include HalloweenEventChestOverlay, ExperienceDropManager, HitDropManager and text-overlay/UI code, all consulting the gameframe-control layout/state rather than treating the class as a passive sprite bundle.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the live custom gameframe control renderer/controller. It intentionally covers both orb/status controls and chat/control-strip interaction.
